Project Summary:
For our project, we developed an interactive educational platform and digital archive detailing the historic Ranger 7, 8, and 9 missions (Block III spacecraft).
How it addresses the challenge: It directly addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge by telling the inspiring story of the hardware left behind by NASA in the 1960s on the Moon, introducing school-age space enthusiasts to these pioneering probes and the science they enabled.

details:
Overview & How It Works: Our project, "NASA Space Exploration Vehicles", is an interactive educational showcase and digital archive designed to introduce students and space enthusiasts to NASA’s iconic Lunar and Martian exploration hardware. It explores four groundbreaking missions across two worlds: the Ranger 7, 8, and 9 hard-landing lunar probes (1964–1965), the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle (1971–1972), the Spirit (MER-A) Mars rover (2004–2011), and the active Curiosity Mars Science Laboratory rover (2012–present). Through engaging comparisons, engineering metrics, timelines, and interactive quiz concepts, users learn how each spacecraft overcame extreme extraterrestrial environments.

Benefits & Intended Impact: Complex aerospace engineering concepts are often difficult for young learners to grasp from dense technical reports alone. By translating official NASA and JPL mission data into accessible, visually structured storytelling and relatable analogies (such as comparing Ranger’s 9,500 km/h impact speed to the Lunar Rover’s 18 km/h top speed), our project sparks curiosity in STEM fields and preserves the technological legacy that paved the way for human spaceflight.

Tools, Data & Creativity: We compiled and verified all mission parameters, launch dates, power systems, and scientific findings directly from official NASA NSSDCA Master Catalog, NASA Science Mission Directorate, Lunar and Planetary Institute (LPI), and JPL Technical Reports. We used Google Slidesand structured digital design principles to transform raw archival data into an engaging, student-friendly learning experience.
